chapters.title: Hoenn
chapters.blurb: From Littleroot Town to the Champion.

steps.title: Help Prof. Birch
steps.text: Go north of Littleroot Town to Route 101 and help Prof. Birch. You will get your first Pokémon.

steps.title: Get the Pokédex
steps.text: Find Birch's kid on Route 103, north of Oldale Town, then return to the lab in Littleroot for your Pokédex.

steps.title: Beat Roxanne
steps.text: Go through Petalburg Woods to Rustboro City and beat Roxanne, the Gym Leader.

steps.title: Chase the Aqua grunt
steps.text: A Team Aqua grunt stole the Devon Goods! Chase him east of Rustboro into Rusturf Tunnel and get them back.

steps.title: Back to Devon Corp.
steps.text: Take the Devon Goods back to Devon Corp. in Rustboro. The President has a letter and a delivery for you.

steps.title: A letter for Steven
steps.text: Ask Mr. Briney, in his cottage on Route 104, to sail you to Dewford Town. Deliver the letter to Steven deep in Granite Cave.

steps.title: Beat Brawly
steps.text: Beat Brawly, the Gym Leader of Dewford Town.

steps.title: Deliver the Devon Goods
steps.text: Sail on to Slateport City and deliver the Devon Goods to Capt. Stern at the Oceanic Museum.

steps.title: Beat Wattson
steps.text: Go north along Route 110 to Mauville City and beat Wattson, the Gym Leader.

steps.title: Chase Team Magma
steps.text: Chase Team Magma: from Route 111 go through the Fiery Path to Fallarbor Town and Meteor Falls, then ride the Route 112 cable car up Mt. Chimney.

steps.title: Beat Flannery
steps.text: Walk down Jagged Pass to Lavaridge Town and beat Flannery, the Gym Leader.

steps.title: Beat Norman
steps.text: Go home to Petalburg City and beat your father Norman, the Gym Leader.

steps.title: The Weather Institute
steps.text: Surf east from Route 118 and go north up Route 119: Team Aqua has taken over the Weather Institute.

steps.title: Beat Winona
steps.text: Beat Winona, the Gym Leader of Fortree City. If something invisible blocks the way, Steven's Devon Scope on Route 120 reveals it.

steps.title: Climb Mt. Pyre
steps.text: Head east toward Lilycove City. Teams Magma and Aqua are after the orbs on Mt. Pyre (Route 122): climb to the summit.

steps.title: Team Magma's hideout
steps.text: Take the Magma Emblem from Mt. Pyre to Jagged Pass. It opens Team Magma's hideout: stop Maxie inside.

steps.title: Team Aqua's hideout
steps.text: Raid Team Aqua's Hideout on the coast east of Lilycove City before Archie gets away.

steps.title: Team Plasma's blockade
steps.text: Team Plasma is blocking Mossdeep's Gym. Find them in the icy room of Shoal Cave, north of Mossdeep City, and drive them off.

steps.title: Beat Tate & Liza
steps.text: Beat Tate & Liza, the Gym Leaders of Mossdeep City.

steps.title: The Space Center
steps.text: Team Magma is attacking the Mossdeep Space Center! Stop them, then talk to Steven.

steps.title: The Seafloor Cavern
steps.text: Dive on Route 128 to reach the Seafloor Cavern and stop Team Aqua.

steps.title: Crisis in Sootopolis
steps.text: Groudon and Kyogre are clashing over Sootopolis City. Help Wallace: wake Rayquaza at the Sky Pillar (Route 131). He gives you HM Waterfall after.

steps.title: Beat Juan
steps.text: Beat Juan, the Gym Leader of Sootopolis City.

steps.title: The Pokémon League
steps.text: Surf to Ever Grande City, cross Victory Road and beat the Elite Four and the Champion.

chapters.title: Post-game
chapters.blurb: Interpol, the Delta Episode, the Ultra Wormholes and the Tapus.

steps.title: Interpol at home
steps.text: Go home to Littleroot Town: Interpol agents Nanu and Anabel are waiting for the new Champion.

steps.title: Steven's Island
steps.text: In Ever Grande City the guard now lets you through. Follow the passage to Steven's Island, where Interpol waits.

steps.title: Wally's Mega Bracelet
steps.text: Wally called from Petalburg City. Hurry: someone is trying to steal his Mega Bracelet!

steps.title: Emergency at Devon
steps.text: Steven called with an emergency. Go to Devon Corp. in Rustboro City.

steps.title: A meteorite fragment
steps.text: Find a meteorite fragment in Granite Cave, near Dewford Town. Zinnia is there too.

steps.title: Prof. Cozmo
steps.text: Bring the meteorite to Prof. Cozmo at the Mossdeep Space Center.

steps.title: The stolen bracelet
steps.text: Team Magma took your Mega Bracelet. Go to Meteor Falls and stop them.

steps.title: Face Zinnia
steps.text: Beat Zinnia in Meteor Falls to get your Mega Bracelet back.

steps.title: Climb the Sky Pillar
steps.text: Climb the Sky Pillar (Route 131) and face Rayquaza.

steps.title: Beyond the sky
steps.text: Ride Rayquaza into space to stop the meteor. Something is waiting beyond the sky.

steps.title: Wallace in Mossdeep
steps.text: Back on the ground, talk to Wallace in Mossdeep City.

steps.title: Trouble in Meteor Falls
steps.text: Return to Steven's Island. Anabel reports trouble deep inside Meteor Falls: find Steven there.

steps.title: The first wormhole
steps.text: Anabel found a new Ultra Wormhole near Pacifidlog Town. Go through it.

steps.title: Report to Anabel
steps.text: Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.

steps.title: The Totem Pokémon
steps.text: Gladion needs you at the Secret Base on Route 111: defeat the Totem Pokémon.

steps.title: The four trials
steps.text: Nanu found strange islands. Pass the four Tapus' trials with the Island Kahunas.

members.text: Tapu Bulu: talk to Nanu on Steven's Island.
Tapu Koko: find Hala in Dewford Town.
Tapu Fini: find Hapu in Slateport City.
Tapu Lele: find Olivia in Mossdeep City.

steps.title: Report to Nanu
steps.text: All four Tapus recognise you. Report to Nanu on Steven's Island.

steps.title: News of Faba
steps.text: Talk to the Devon Scout on Steven's Island: he has news about Faba. The Ultra Wormhole Faba used will not let you in before his report.

steps.title: Chase Faba
steps.text: The Devon Scout tracked Faba to the Ultra Wormhole in the Scorched Slab (Route 120). Follow him, and bring a way past whirlpools.

steps.title: Report to Anabel
steps.text: Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.

steps.title: Train with Champions
steps.text: Anabel says Steven and the former Champions are waiting in the lobby. Train with them.

steps.title: Report to Anabel
steps.text: Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.

steps.title: The strange weather
steps.text: The Devon Scout says the Ultra Wormhole fluctuations follow abnormal weather. Find the drought (Terra Cave) or the downpour (Marine Cave).

steps.title: Report to Anabel
steps.text: Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.

steps.title: Mt. Pyre's wormhole
steps.text: The Devon Scout detected an Ultra Wormhole at the top of Mt. Pyre. Go through it.

steps.title: Report to Anabel
steps.text: Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.

steps.title: Shoal Cave's wormhole
steps.text: Next fluctuation: the icy room of Shoal Cave, where Team Plasma was. Go through the Ultra Wormhole there.

steps.title: Report to Anabel
steps.text: Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.

steps.title: Route 116's wormhole
steps.text: Next fluctuation: the Ultra Wormhole on Route 116.

steps.title: Report to Anabel
steps.text: Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.

steps.title: Catch Faba
steps.text: Faba was seen alone near the Mirage Tower in the Route 111 desert. Go and catch him.

steps.title: Report to Anabel
steps.text: Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.

steps.title: Find Red
steps.text: Find Red. The last Ultra Wormholes are deep in Meteor Falls and Granite Cave.

steps.title: Report to Anabel
steps.text: Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.

steps.title: The 18 Z-Crystals
steps.text: Collect all 18 Z-Crystals, then go to Pacifidlog Town. The crystals open the way to Team Rainbow Rocket's castle.

steps.title: Storm the castle
steps.text: Storm Team Rainbow Rocket's castle and defeat them at the Mountain Top.

steps.title: Steven is waiting
steps.text: Return to Steven's Island: Steven is waiting.

steps.title: A Silver Symbol
steps.text: Earn a Silver Symbol at the Battle Frontier - for one, beat Salon Maiden Anabel, the 35th battle of a Battle Tower Singles streak. Then see Scott in his Frontier house for a ferry ticket to the World Championships.

steps.title: To Champion Island
steps.text: Take the ferry from Lilycove City to Champion Island for the World Championships. Familiar faces are waiting.

chapters.title: Sinnoh
chapters.blurb: The eight Sinnoh gyms and the League.

steps.title: Sail to Sinnoh
steps.text: Show Waji's boat ticket to the sailor at Lilycove City's harbor and sail to Canalave City in Sinnoh.

steps.title: The Sinnoh Badges
steps.text: Earn the eight Sinnoh Gym Badges. Still to beat:

members.text: Roark - Oreburgh City
Gardenia - Eterna City
Maylene - Veilstone City
Crasher Wake - Pastoria City
Fantina - Hearthome City
Byron - Canalave City
Candice - Snowpoint City
Volkner - Sunyshore City

steps.title: The Sinnoh League
steps.text: Take Victory Road to the Sinnoh League and beat the Elite Four and Cynthia.

chapters.title: Lost Artifacts
chapters.blurb: Waji, the Plates, Giratina, Arceus and Volo.

steps.title: The 17 Plates
steps.text: Collect the 17 Plates hidden in Hoenn and Sinnoh. Waji, at the Spear Pillar on top of Mt. Coronet, gives hints.

members.text: Fist Plate: the Sealed Chamber, the ruin under the sea of Route 134 (Dive).
Sky Plate: the house full of Wingull on Route 119.
Toxic Plate: a little hill in the marsh on Route 212, toward Pastoria City.
Earth Plate: Granite Cave near Dewford, in the room at the back of the first floor.
Stone Plate: Oreburgh Mine, next to Oreburgh City.
Insect Plate: the Solaceon Ruins, in one of the large chambers.
Spooky Plate: the Lost Tower on Route 209, near the Solaceon Ruins.
Iron and Dread Plates: the Team Rocket hideout under the Mauville Game Corner.
Flame Plate: the summit of Mt. Chimney.
Splash Plate: underwater on Route 126, around Sootopolis (Dive).
Meadow Plate: in the shade of the trees on rainy Route 120.
Zap Plate: a hidden corner of New Mauville.
Mind Plate: the Solaceon Ruins, away from the Insect Plate.
Icicle Plate: the mountain man's hut on snowy Route 217. He gives it to you.
Draco Plate: the Meteor Temple, reached from Meteor Falls.
Pixie Plate: deep inside Mt. Coronet.

steps.title: The Spear Pillar altar
steps.text: Step onto the altar at the Spear Pillar with all 17 Plates. The rift that opens will test everything you have.

steps.title: A way through
steps.text: Waji senses the rift's energy in Celestic Town. Visit its ruins with Dialga and Palkia both caught to open a way into the Distortion World, or go in from the islet on Route 129.

steps.title: The reverse world
steps.text: Enter the Distortion World and face the ruler of the reverse world. Ways in: the new passage at the Spear Pillar or Sendoff Spring, or the islet on Route 129 in Hoenn.

steps.title: The Plates' owner
steps.text: Keep all 17 Plates in your Bag and return to the Mountain Top above Team Rainbow Rocket's castle. The Plates' true owner is waiting.

steps.title: Cogita in Hearthome
steps.text: Arceus sent you to Hearthome City. Find Cogita in a house on the west side of town, with all 17 Plates in your Bag.

steps.title: Through the rift
steps.text: Step through the space-time rift in Cogita's house. It leads to the Hisui region.

steps.title: Find Cogita in Hisui
steps.text: Find Cogita in Hisui. Rei (Mingyao) at the Deertrack Heights base camp flies you around: look on Firespit Island.

steps.title: The clan leaders
steps.text: Visit the clan leaders at the hot spring in the Alabaster Icelands.

members.text: Adaman, Diamond Clan
Irida, Pearl Clan

steps.title: The Primeval Cave
steps.text: Diamond and Pearl point to the foot of Mt. Coronet. Enter the Primeval Cave: whoever is behind the rifts is inside.

steps.title: Back to base camp
steps.text: Volo is beaten. Return to base camp in Hisui: Rei and Cogita have news.

steps.title: A sleeping woman
steps.text: In Solaceon Town in Sinnoh, a woman has slept in a nightmare since her offerings at the Lost Tower. Hear her husband out.

steps.title: Wake the sleeper
steps.text: Bring the Lunar Wing to the sleeping woman in Solaceon Town and wake her.

steps.title: The Lost Tower
steps.text: The oppressive presence in the Lost Tower has lifted. Something pitch-black stirs deep inside: face the phantom of nightmares.

steps.title: One more legend
steps.text: Catch Tornadus, Thundurus and Landorus, then show Cogita on Firespit Island in Hisui. She has one more legend to tell.

steps.title: Kitty's dried fish
steps.text: Kitty in the three-floor house on Steven's Island wants dried fish. Find the Dried Fish on Prelude Beach in Hisui and bring it to her for a nameless stone.

steps.title: The summit
steps.text: With Kitty's nameless stone in your Bag, climb toward the Sacred Temple in Hisui's highlands. A dread of unknown origin hangs over the summit.

steps.title: Cogita's invitation
steps.text: Cogita waits on Champion Island with more to tell.

final.title: Beyond the story
final.text: Every story objective is complete! Still out there: a trial of six battles at Cogita's retreat off Sootopolis, and Adaman and Irida's clan treasures for a trainer who brings Dialga or Palkia.
